question: Why Is Chick-fil-A Closed on Sunday?
quick_answer: Chick-fil-A is closed every Sunday because founder S. Truett Cathy made it a day of rest. He started the practice back in 1946 at his first diner, the Dwarf Grill, so his staff could rest and spend time with family, tied to his own faith, and he carried it into Chick-fil-A when it launched in 1967. Almost every Chick-fil-A in the US stays closed on Sundays.

body.heading: A rule that predates Chick-fil-A
body.text: The Sunday closing goes back further than Chick-fil-A itself. Founder S. Truett Cathy began closing on Sundays in 1946 at his first diner, the Dwarf Grill in Hapeville, Georgia. When he launched Chick-fil-A in 1967, he kept the same practice, and it has been part of the company ever since.

body.heading: Rest and faith
body.text: The main reasons are rest and faith. Cathy wanted every employee to have at least one guaranteed day off each week to rest, be with family, and worship if they chose to. The decision was rooted in his own Christian beliefs, and the company has described it as a way of valuing people over extra sales.

body.heading: Does it ever open on Sunday?
body.text: As a rule, no. The vast majority of Chick-fil-A locations stay closed every Sunday. There are a small number of unusual exceptions, such as certain locations inside airports or stadiums that are operated differently, but the standard across the chain is closed on Sundays.

faqs.q: Is every Chick-fil-A closed on Sunday?
faqs.a: Almost all of them. The standard company policy is to close on Sundays. A few unusual locations, such as some in airports or stadiums, can differ, but the normal rule is closed.

faqs.q: When did Chick-fil-A start closing on Sundays?
faqs.a: The practice goes back to 1946, when founder Truett Cathy closed his first diner, the Dwarf Grill, on Sundays. He carried it into Chick-fil-A from its 1967 launch.

faqs.q: Why does Chick-fil-A close on Sundays?
faqs.a: Founder Truett Cathy wanted employees to have a guaranteed day of rest, tied to his Christian faith. The company has kept the policy ever since.
